Subject: Redwood pilot - quick recap & next steps

Hi Jordan 

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum for the pilot: 

- Problem: Acme needs consistent, low-latency inference for customer support summarization across en-US and en-GB.
- Proposed pilot: 2-week proof-of-value on Dedicated capacity (2x A10G equivalent) with the standard PII-safe config and prefix caching for common prompts.
- Success metrics: avg p95 latency < 200ms, throughput 100 req/s, summary quality >= 90% F1 on the supplied eval set.

Next steps:
1) I will send a mutual action plan + SOW for review (attached).
2) Marissa will coordinate legal/DPA conversation and capture any redlines.
3) Can we aim to kick off the pilot week of Mar 9? If that changes, tell us preferred timing.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_ACME.xlsx (mutual action plan)

Open questions I pulled from the call:
- How will procurement review work at Acme (SOW + DPA cadence)?
- Any additional security docs we should pre-send (SOC2 cert, network diagram)?

I'll follow up on scheduling a short kickoff once you confirm timing.

Best,
